summary: Durable orientation monument for multi-LLM, multi-environment coordination on the same project. Long-horizon framing (decades-to-centuries of compounding work) grounded in existing GitHub surfaces. Revenue claim remains 0. Goal: voluntary, evidence-based collaboration across devices and models without central coercion.
core_principle: Many agents, one shared evidence chain. Local-first when possible. GitHub + Actions as durable control plane. Failure telemetry and compounding assets are first-class. No agent claims revenue without independent external fossils.
existing_surfaces_to_build_on: KelpCoin/llm-supabase-github-bridge (evidence contract, figure-eight status, local workers)
coordination_pattern: Pyramid without slavery: each agent (phone, desktop, local GPU, cloud) does one bounded job, leaves a receipt + compounding asset, and hands off. No central owner forces work; the shared ledger and clear handoffs let voluntary agents align on the same long project.
long_horizon_note: Treat every successful package as a stone that future agents can stand on. The economic goal is real external value over time; the immediate discipline is honest telemetry, reusable components, and fail-closed revenue claims.
